commit.message:
[vllm, hardware] fix: enable vLLM-Ascend RL mode by default (#8585)

### What does this PR do?

Default rl_config.enabled to true when preparing vLLM engine arguments
on Ascend. This disables NZ weights for sleep/wake and weight updates
across actor and reward-model rollouts.

Preserve explicit user overrides and other additional configuration.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: ...
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This
will be checked by the CI)
- `{modules}` include `fsdp`, `megatron`, `veomni`, `sglang`, `vllm`,
`rollout`, `trainer`, `ci`, `training_utils`, `recipe`, `hardware`,
`deployment`, `ray`, `worker`, `single_controller`, `misc`, `perf`,
`model`, `algo`, `env`, `tool`, `ckpt`, `doc`, `data`, `cfg`, `reward`,
`fully_async`, `one_step_off`
- If this PR involves multiple modules, separate them with `,` like
`[megatron, fsdp, doc]`
  - `{type}` is in `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `chore`, `test`
- If this PR breaks any API (CLI arguments, config, function signature,
etc.), add `[BREAKING]` to the beginning of the title.
  - Example: `[BREAKING][fsdp, megatron] feat: dynamic batching`

                 "rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm may not set args that verl derives from its config: "

             )
+        if is_torch_npu_available(check_device=False):
+            # Ascend RL defaults disable NZ weights for sleep/wake and weight updates.
+            additional_config = dict(engine_kwargs.get("additional_config") or {})
+            rl_config = dict(additional_config.get("rl_config") or {})
+            rl_config.setdefault("enabled", True)
+            additional_config["rl_config"] = rl_config
+            engine_kwargs["additional_config"] = additional_config
